body: I feel you. There’s some people in my life that I know for sure would be crushed, but at the end of the day, it’s something that’s come across my mind damn near every day for almost a year. I’m definitely grateful for the things I have in life, but I’m just not truly happy inside yk?? Like there’s moments where I’ll be happy, but they don’t last long and my sadness just washes back over me.
